description: This file defines a scraper class for extracting recipe data from quakeroats.com, including methods for retrieving title, author, ingredients, instructions, and timing information.

classes.name: QuakerOats
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe information from quakeroats.com

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname associated with the scraper, 'quakeroats.com'.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author of the recipe, 'The Quaker Oats Company'.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the recipe title from the HTML page.

methods.name: _get_metadata_from_span
methods.description: Retrieves text content from a span element with an ID containing a specific partial ID.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Extracts preparation time in minutes from the page.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Extracts cooking time in minutes from the page.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Retrieves the number of servings the recipe yields.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time by summing prep and cook times.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts a list of ingredients with quantities from the recipe page.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients based on specific HTML structure.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Retrieves and joins recipe instructions steps.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Extracts the meta description content for the recipe.
